members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add the same fix: iterate `_sse_stream_writers`, call `writer.close()` on each, clear the dict inside `terminate()`, and terminate all active sessions in the manager's lifespan `finally` block. (2 PRs)

members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2259 is a strict superset of #2253: it adds an idempotency guard (`if self._terminated: return`) before setting the flag, preventing double-termination races, and its `_sse_stream_writers` loop omits the `# pragma: no cover` annotation that #2253 added (keeping coverage honest). Both touch the same lines in the same two files; #2259 handles one additional edge case #2253 misses.
